description: After turning heads late 2020 with the 90’s house leaning Dewi, Komang further flaunts her versatility, returning with this bent and evocative neo-soul declaration. ‘Flex’ is inspired by feminine disruption, demi-gods and night drives with the windows down - a song about expanding into oneself, and being inspired by the power of others.
